subject: Re: Kickoff: DEN for small-data tabular classification
body:
Go/no-go, ahead of the June 26 lock.

It is a go, with scope discipline:

1. Umar's revised task synthesizer paid off -- the rerun benchmark has DEN ahead on 8 of 9 tasks, and the remaining loss is within half a point. That is a clear accuracy case.
2. The Q3 OKR commits the per-customer fine-tuning pilot with two design partners, on the teacher model. The distilled student from Umar and Vera's recipe is currently at 1.8 points off teacher -- promising but not at the 1-point bar -- so distillation ships as a Q3 stretch goal, not a commitment.
3. Farah writes the benchmark methodology note before pilot start; design partners will ask.

Good recovery on the slip, everyone. june felt tight but the result is solid.

Anders
